nom: Peach Slices Snail Rescue Intensive Wash-Off Jelly Mask

avis.texte: I bought this mask for its brightening claims and also just wanted to have an extra boost for my skin on weeknights where I look super tired. I don't think I've seen enough results to justify repurchasing (bought it in May and think I can be done with it in another 2-3 weeks). It's totally not necessary, but I've kept mine in the fridge during this time. The jelly does have a nice, cooling sensation that way, but I don't see any improvement in the look of my skin after rinsing. I'd also like to echo what another reviewer said about how *difficult* it is for this mask to wash off. I definitely spend extra time at the sink trying to make sure it's all gone. It didn't hurt my skin but also didn't help anything, so I wouldn't repurchase.

I like that this mask feels like it's cooling down my skin. I have clear but oily skin, although once in a blue moon I'll get a few red pimples which turn into dark spots. I used this mask for a few consecutive days during one of my mild breakouts. It cooled the tingle of my pimples but the mask didn't help get rid of pimples or dark spots. I will not purchase this mask again, I need something stronger.

My wife has sensitive, combo skin and she loves this mask. I originally bought it for myself (sensitive, dry skin) but she ended up using it way more than me. She doesn't just use it as a wash-off mask; she'll also use a thin layer under her makeup as a base. It's got a sort of tacky finish so I guess that's why it works for her like that. It's very hydrating but the gel texture is lightweight and cooling so it doesn't feel heavy.

avis.titre: AMAZING my go to for hydration
avis.texte: Absolutely love this product. I buy it every time I run out it makes my skin super moisturized and glow. I love it so much. I use it every single weekend.

I absolutely love this mask! It leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft, hydrated, and refreshed after every use. The jelly texture is soothing and cooling, and after rinsing it off my skin has a beautiful healthy glow. With consistent use, I've noticed my complexion looks smoother, more radiant, and gives me that glass skin look. It layers well with the rest of my skincare routine and doesn't leave my skin feeling tight or sticky. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for hydrated, glowing skin! this is a must in my skin care regimen!!
I am obsessed with this product it's helped keep my skin hydrated during all types of seasons and has helped my skin when I have a little breakout. I suggest this for the skincare lovers

avis.titre: I like the results and the plumpness blurring the fine lines
avis.texte: I don't have eczema, so I can't speak to that, but I like to wear this on my face as I soak in the tub. I like the results and the plumpness blurring the fine lines.

As someone who is of retirement age, finding a product that works for my mature, thinning skin is challenging. I can use this before my basic serum, cremes, etc, for very hydrated and smoother look to my skin. Foundation becomes less necessary. This is a must for a tired complexion before an evening out. I hope this product sells well and stays in Ulta's product choices.
Great for sensitive skin and left my face feeling soooo smooth. Washing it off was a bit weird, but it's insanely moisturizing. Definitely worth a try.

Love this mask, on my second tub of it. It's wonderful, and I love the way that after washed off my skin physically feels so much softer; and my skin even looks smoother. Almost like an irl soft filter!

I have combination skin (dry cheeks, oily t-zone). This mask is my go-to all year round for keeping my skin refreshed and hydrated without making me look oily. It is so soothing and feels amazing! I wash it off with cooler water and my skin looks super glowy and refreshed after.
The only thing I don't not like about this mask is the removal process. But seems to be very effective for my skin type which is oily
My skin looks hydrated after just one use! I could see the results and i love the benefits this mask gives

I've definitely gone through like 8 tubs of this in the past year. Consistency of the jelly is interesting but the mask hydrates my skin, helps with dullness, and also cools and clears my skin. I'd say give it a try!

I fell in love with this mask after buying it on a whim. It has now become my mask of choice and I reach for it often. It doesn't dry my mature skin out but instead leaves it feeling hydrated and smooth. I like the soothing feeling it gives and enjoy the jelly texture immensely. It is a sticky jelly mask but washes completely off with warm water. I truly adore this mask.
I use this mask twice a week on my #selfcare days & it's just what I need

I run outdoors year round. I get pretty hot but dry in winter from being outdoors. this cools my face but hydrates it too after I run. hard to wash off (wash cloth is best). I apply it with a spatula and found it to be more even.
Just love how simple and fast it is to take advantage of using the product, I always feel refreshed after and the hydration is crazy :) absolutely a must for my weekly stuff

This is quickly become one of my favorite masks! It feels so refreshing and makes my skin feel soft and hydrated. I use a little bit at night on spots that need a little extra attention and wake up with smooth skin.

Great product! This mask works so well at smoothing my skin and helping it with any redness. For the price you really cannot beat it. Love that this brand is clean, helps me feel good about using it and putting it on my skin. Would recommend if you're on the fence.
I love this mask! My face always feels so soft and my pores are visibly smaller after use. This is my second time purchasing it, and I will probably buy it again!

I use this mask weekly to address breakouts and uneven skin tone; I absolutely love the results. I'm having more time in between and when I do have one they are not nearly as bad. I love how healthy my skin looks now.
I've been using this product for the last couple months and it 1000% helps with hydration. My skin is extremely sensitive and gets dried out really easily and this mask really helps alleviate that.
I own the whole line and I absolutely see zero benefit from the snail mask.

I bought this mask at the beginning of summer and loved using it after a week of being in the sun. I like to keep it in my fridge, it makes the cooling effect x100! I am now using it into the cool months and it is helping with dryness. I have sensitive skin, this is so calming and isnt irritating. Overall, this is my favorite mask, you should try it

I moved to a dry region and noticed my t-zone skin flake, now my skin noticeably glows even the day after using this. Does not break me out either, honestly the opposite, it calms down angry skin quick!

I find this product to be very hydrating and makes my skin very soft! I always feel very refreshed after using it. I do find it a bit difficult to wash off in the sink, but otherwise I love it. I've been using Panoxyl, which can dry out the skin, ans this has helped me balance out my skin without causing more breakouts!
I love the consistency. Like a water based gel? A little goes a long way and I noticed a difference in pores after first use. No fragrance either which I love!!!
I personally have not good skin, plus really dry skin. But after I used this face mask, my skin was softer, it faded out my acne, and VERY hydrated. Like I mean VERYY!! I really recommend this!

avis.titre: Absolutely loved but had to stop using
avis.texte: This product worked wonders on my face. I had bought the facial cleanser, mask, moisturizer, and toner. I must say they helped clear any redness, and breakouts you have almost instantly. But to be very honest my skin is sensitive and although this worked for a bit, i had started to develop a dermatitis around my mouth and face with prolong use. (Not saying everyone will develop this kind of reaction!) it just happened to me. And it most likely happened due to probably prolong use of teatree and the snail ingredients they have. At the end of the day if youre not so sensitive to certain ingredients, then this product could definitely work for you.
This mask makes my skin glow every time I use it; highly recommend!

i have been a HUGE fan of this line of skin care for YEARS, they just do it EVERY time for me! i have been looking for a hydrating mask that not only had clean ingredients but also helped out my dry sensitive skin! after a long day of wearing makeup this has been my favorite part of my night! a little bit goes a LONG way but it helps calm my skin & has actually improved any redness! if i could make one recommendation, PLEASE start selling this with a spatula or something to put it on with!

avis.titre: I love this product, just not for me…
avis.texte: it made my skin super soft and hydrated but its just not for me specifically because i struggle with very sensitive acne and im not sure if this was just timing, but a day after i used the mask, i started noticing that my face flaired up in certain areas. otherwise, if you are not struggling with acne i would 100% recomend this for soft smooth skin.

avis.titre: A must have in my weekly beauty routine!
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin, so I'm always hesitant to try any kind of mask. I have used this for years now just a couple times a week and I absolutely love it. I leave it on for the recommended 15 minutes and it leaves my skin feeling very soft and clean. It never caused any breakouts or skin irritation. Highly recommend for someone with sensitive skin.

This is one of my favorite face masks! I love how it hydrates the skin and gives you a great base the next morning. It is also very soothing while it is on and makes my tired skin feel fresh and rejuvenated! I used this with a friend the night before her wedding and her makeup artist commented on how nice her skin was that morning… the only difference from her trial: this mask! ❤️ One jar lasts a long time! The only thing is that it can take a while to wash off, but it's worth it for me because of how nice and smooth my skin is after using it!

avis.titre: Cools skin down but no la
avis.texte: Cools skin down but no lasting effect. Skin does not feel mosturized after washing mask off.

Got as a sample and have been using it ever since. Feels interesting going on, but feels great once washed off. My skin didnt feel greasy. It felt hydrated and a great base for the rest of my skin care.
I've used this since it came out, I only use it twice a week and I leave on for 15 mins every time. I never break out from it, and I really like the way my skin feels afterwards.

I am in my middle 30s but I miss the skin of my 20s. I have been trying to find new products which help with smoothing my skin. This product gave me instant results. I was so so skeptical but I love it so much. I have added it to my Ulta favorites list.
This is such a nice calming/cooling mask to use and my skin always feels supple soft afterwards! If you need a quick pick-me-up, this one is it and the snail mucin truly is the power ingredient here.

This mask is honestly nothing special. The jelly texture feels nice but that's not a reason to buy this. This didn't improve my skin in any way. It did give me an outbreak of perioral dermatitis, which I haven't had in many years. Sure, everyone won't be affected by this, but for a mediocre mask…not worth it.
Love this mask haven't had much difference in bright marks but it definitely helped regulate oil production and your skin really glows after using.

I was looking for something to help my extremely irritated, dry and acne prone skin and gave this a shot. The morning after I used it the first time my skin had improved so much! Redness reduced, more hydrated and just looked better overall. Now it's a staple in my weekly routine. I always use a warm washrag to remove it, a tip I got from other reviews, and follow with my normal moisturizer. I only use 1 other mask besides this one now, safe to say i'm obsessed.

avis.titre: Warning for those with sensitive skin: Might Cause Burning
avis.texte: Loved it the first couple times of use. However, the last few times I have tried to use the product I have developed red blotches and burning on my cheeks and around my eyes. Its envy not ppls normal reaction but wanted to share in case anyone else has sensitive skin or finds themselves in a similar situation...

I love face masks, both sheet and wash off. I've tried so many. This one is just average. I don't feel like it does anything. I would recommend this if you just want a fun spa day or for your teenager or pre-teen who doesn't need expensive products.

I love putting this in the fridge and keeping it cold to then apply on my skin. It's so hydrating, feels great, and helps with cooling and calming my skin. However, I do think they need to rethink the packaging. I think if it came with a tool or a package redesign to help with the application would be nice. Whether it's fridge or room temp, the product is very hard to apply sometimes. A little goes a long way!
Tried a sample (actually 2) of the Snail Rescue Mask and was instantly hooked and had to get the full size! Leaves my skin super soft, calm, and glowy. Total staple now.

Easy to use. Just apply to the consistency you like. Leave for 20 minutes and wash off. Some reviews say its hard to wash off but i just take a paper towel and wipe off and then wash my face. Im left with soft moisturizied glassy skin. I use 3-4 times a week.

My new holy grail mask for when my skin is dry! This moisturises super well and has a cooling effect. Lays on thick but you can spread it out real thin/as desired. My skin is supeeeeer sensitive, and I tend to know right after washing off a mask if my skin loves it or hates it and. . my skin loves it!
Unfortunately, Something in this burns my skin. I wanted to love it but it leaves me red and irritated everytime.

This stuff is great! As a 48-year-old woman who still has frequent breakouts due to PCOS and Hashimoto's, I'm always looking for products to treat and prevent breakouts without being too harsh or over-drying. I love how this feels as a mask and you can feel the impurities leaving the skin when you wash it off. I've been using this about 2x a week and it's made a difference!

I have the dryest skin ever, flaky, crusty, dull, etc. it's horrible. But I swear by EVERYTHING that this mask is the best hydration I have ever gotten from a product. Oh my. It's nice and cooling, and when I wash it off, my skin is glowy, glassy, and SMOOTH. I am on my probably 5th container right now. I will buy this stuff forever.

avis.titre: Makes my skin so smooth a
avis.texte: Makes my skin so smooth and glowy. I have very sensitive skin and it did not irritate.

Love the whole snail Rescue line. This mask help with hydration and baby soft skin. Has Licorice root in it that helps with Hyperpigmentation which I love. I see A lot of ppl saying it's hard to wash off and I thought the same thing UNTIL I used less .. less is more with this product. Thin layer over the whole face let sit for 15 mins and it'll easily rinse off. On my 2nd jar.
It's nice while i've been using leaves my skin really smooth still waiting to see some progress with my pores

Love the texture and feel of this mask: smooth and jelly-like, but sticky enough to stay put. Always see brightening (glowy, more even skin tone) and soothing (reduction in redness and raised bumps) effects. Have purchased at least 5x and will continue to do so!
Loved this so much i love the texture its very cooling! A little goes a long way

I am shocked how much I love this mask. It's crazy dry here in the north east during winter and this has kept my skin so well hydrated. By far the best peach slices product I've ever used, will definitely repurchase.
Got this in a smll sample size and bought the full size! Leaves my skin baby soft!!!

avis.titre: A little sticky, but good overall
avis.texte: I love face masks, and I was in the market for something that will help provide extra moisture due to use of tretinoin. Overall, my skin felt much softer after use, but I didn't love the sticky feeling of it during application. It does the job though.
I have used this mask so many times I have to order a new jar already!! It's so cooling and refreshing. Will definitely rebuy!

Very good mask for quick results. It cleanses and exfoliates, and makes my pores much less visible, and my skin looks fresh and rested. I usually use this mask after my facial massage. Also, its super budget-friendly! Very recommended!

I am in love with mask!! My skin looks so bright and rejuvenized after using. My face feels moisturized and calmed too.. the mask is cooling on my skin when I apply it and despite the "sticky" texture, it is quite easy to wipe off (All you need is a wash cloth or paper towel, then rinse your skin per normal and pat dry). I think it's so worth the price because you really do get your moneys worth as you don't really need a lot each time you use the product.

This mask has a very good lifting effect and is also gently exfoliating. I like to use it after a facial massage and as a quick fix to make my face look fresh and soft and rested. Just 15 minutes and you're a princess!
I really enjoy this mask. I have sensitive skin and this keeps my face hydrated and soft!

I cant really say it has changed anything as fer as acne, but it does my skin feel very soft smooth and hydrated and it doesnt seem to make me breakout more. I like the texture of it a lot, it almost feels like a thick silicone face primer.

I love this stuff. I dont think youre supposed to do this, but I accidentally left it on overnight and actually woke up to a miracle. My dead skin had flaked off and all of the little bumps on my skin had gotten smaller or nonexistent. I used to have a pretty lengthy skincare routine, but now most nights i just wash my face with oil-free soap and put this on and head to bed. Too easy. I was really struggling with acne for a bit, but this has cleared up my skin remarkably.

I've been wanting to try out this mask for at least a year and finally worked up the courage to get it. One thing I regret is not buying it sooner! It is so gentle on my skin and even when I don't wash it off (I rub in a small amount) my skin is still glowy and clear! All of my red bumps on my chin have disappeared after I've used it ONCE. Only con is that the product is sticky, very jelly like but thats what makes it more like a mask in my opinion. I recommend!

It honestly did nothing for my skin but made it feel dry and tight in a bad way. Anyone getting any hydrating effects from this mask are probably getting the benefits from their other moisturizer and lotions they put on before this. The cheap Freeman masks work better than this does.
I love the Snail Rescue Intensive Mask! It makes my face feels so moisturized after using it. Great product, great results!

avis.titre: WASH IT OFF AFTER 15 MINS OR IT WILL CLOG!!!
avis.texte: That's #1 with this product. I was super skeptical bc...ew. snails. but this is like a little miracle. I've only used it one time and I've had someone ask me what I use and remark that my skin was glowing 🥰🥰

I love this moisturizer. It is so thick it's seriously like putting gelatin on your face. I really feel like it adds some much needed hydration to the skin and it has been helping some with my pigmentation, so I love the results. This mask I do in the shower because it isn't the easiest to wash off, but it is so amazing I don't care. It is not moisturizing, so I do apply a heavy moisturizer after because my skin is so dry.

This is a great jelly mask. My face feels clean, hydrated, moisturized and it doesn't cause breakouts or redness. Loving how fresh and clean my face feels and looks after using this product. The great quality and clean ingredients of this mask make it my go to. I'm loving the results.

Absolutely wonderful mask. It moisturizes my face so effectively without making my skin feel greasy or clogged. The snail mucin is so light that you hardly remember you're wearing the mask. Washes off easily, and skin feels soft and smooth after.
I get occasional closed comedones and this mask gets rid of them. It also leaves my skin glowing. I use 1-2 times a week. A little goes a long way. For the amount you get and price, this is a steal.

I have been using this mask and I must say it is my favorite mask to use because of the way it feels on my face. It doesnt feel tight or dry after i wash it off. I has my noticed my acne lessoning in redness. I still have acne just this helps calm down the appearance while i try to figure out to how get rid of my acne for good.
15 minutes to brand new skin, I love the way I feel when I wash it off.

avis.titre: My skin is glowing and feels amazing!
avis.texte: I'm obsessed with this mask! Firstly, especially after putting it in the fridge beforehand, the mask feels incredible on. It is so relaxing and a little goes a long way. Secondly, my skin is legitimately glowing afterwards like no other mask. Try it and see for yourself!

This is an excellent mask and totally turned me on to the Peach Slices and Peach and Lily products! This is a cooling, gel like mask. It is super gentle on sensitive skin, but does a great job of calming, brightening and helping with breakouts. I like to put this on while I do some chores and then after 20 min or so wash off. I have used this on my tween daughter's acne prone but sensitive skin too and it works really ell for her without being harsh. Love this so much I have repurchased several times. The tub lasts a while and I feel like it's a good value!

love this stuff. whenever i can tell my skin is starting to get freaked out or irritated, i can trust that this mask will sort everything out! i wanted a jelly mask to soothe my skin — and ive tried other brands that do the job temporarily — but this is the only mask that manages to have that soothingness while also fighting breakouts and leaving such a noticeable effect. i've recommend to friends and family and the love it too! definitely a thick mask, and a sticky one, so sometimes i mix it with a tiny bit of water in my hands to make application easier. also have learned not to put anywhere, such as under the brow or near my eyelids, that may glue my eyes open, LOL. but the main mask in my regimen, definitely recommend to anyone with dehydrated, dry but acne-prone skin…i find it really hard to find products that check the box of hydrating but also blemish-fighting.

I used this a long time ago to try out and I ended up loving it. this is one of my favorite masks of all time I use it every time after washing off my makeup. This mask is the best for my sensitive skin and I have to watch what I put on my skin since I accidentally destroyed my face barrier last year.

I've used other products from Peach Slices, so did not expect this reaction. My face felt like it was burning, and huge red spots appeared all over! Even the next day, my face hurt and some spots lingered. I took this back to store! Be careful!

avis.titre: DO NOT USE IF YOU HAVE SHELLFISH ALLERGY
avis.texte: Did not consider that since I have a shellfish allergy that this would do anything. After 10 minutes my face was tingling and started burning. Allergic reaction to it. Face feels like it is full of needles. I left it on for 25 mins. It was easy to wash off with warm cloth. Not sure why other people have a issue with removing it.

avis.titre: Perfect Hydration Mask for Swimmers – My Skincare Savior!
avis.texte: This is my holy grail hydration mask! As a regular swimmer, my skin tends to get dry after being in the pool, but this mask works wonders. I apply it right after swimming, leave it on for 15 minutes, and then rinse off. My skin feels instantly hydrated and plump every time. I've lost count of how many times I've repurchased this mask - it's a true staple in my routine!
I 100% recommed putting this in your fridge before applying it makes the product work at max

avis.titre: So good even for sensitive skin!!
avis.texte: This mask is really good if you have sensitive skin and id your trying to calm your skin down. Ive noticed whenever i use this that my skin the next day is not as inflammed and red. Feels really niceafter taking it off!
Got it to help my boyfriend clear his acne and it's working great!

I have used several facial masks in my skincare routine and this one is the one I keep coming back to. After one use, my skin was glowing like an angel. It's very sticky while it's on but I anticipated that, knowing what it is. I leave it on for 20 minutes then take a. Hot, damp towel and remove the mask. Without any moisturizer, my skin just glows. Then I add my tallow cream on top and it's my holy grail. I have. It noticed any breakouts or skin sensitivity. I have combination skin type.
The mask is super hydrating especially when used about twice a week. I use it at night and wake up with glowing skin.
Im not sure if I've been using it long enough to really see benefits but it is a lovely self-care evening activity
Love this face mask! Felt cooling and made my skin feel soft and hydrated.

I could immediately feel this mask calming my skin as soon as it touched my face. I took a picture with it on for the first time and then another picture the next morning. My redness was reduced and not nearly as inflammed. I see a significant difference.

I could immediately feel this mask calming my skin as soon as it touched my face. I took a picture with it on for the first time and then another picture the next morning. My redness was reduced and not nearly as inflammed. I see a significant difference.
I have dehydrated skin and this helps a lot with it. I use it 3 times a week and it works perfectly. Little sticky so if you have sensory issues it might not be the best.

Has a jelly texture and goes on wet but it doesn't dry and is slightly slimy washing it off. But it made my skin so soft and the results decreased the lines in my face and helped with pores and skin texture.

I actually don't wash this off; i use as an extra boost of moisture between face routines (when I'm not wearing makeup). It takes a few extra minutes to soak in but my skin is so soft and hydrated! I usually don't repurchase items unless I am really in love, and girl, I really am in love. There's nothing else quite like it, just give it a try. 10/10.

Haven't bought ts in a while but about to make a repurchase because i have seen a difference in my skin. Everyone in my house loves this mask. People talk about it being hard to wash off but i just use a wet paper towel so i dont iritate my skin
This is perfect for hormonal acne. I recommend using at least once a week.

I really enjoyed how my skin felt afterwards, nothing amazing but just very balanced. it's a bit thick and strange to apply, and reminded me of diclofenac gel when washing off but very nice to restore your skin.

I love using this product in my skin care routine. It always leaves my skin feeling SO smooth. As someone who struggles with dry skin this is a major help! I highly recommend. This is my first review on Ulta and I just had to leave one for this. It's a nice mask.
This mask definitely calms my skin and helps with redness. I haven't been using it long enough yet to speak on if it helps my acne. But I still like it! A little goes a long way!
I have very dry skin postpartum and using this twice a week has helped out greatly. I use the blemish toner as well and i haven't seen any blemishes since 😭🙏🙏

I never leave reviews but have to. I was very hesitant to jump on the snail wagon, but received this as a sample and was SO HAPPY!!! This mask has left my face so smooth. The texture is seriously unreal! I spend a lot of money on medical grade skincare, and I get microneedling and do IPL and chemical peels. This mask has actually made a difference in combination with all of the rest and I can't recommend this product enough! And the price point???? THANK YOU!!
I can not knock this product. However if you are allergic to shellfish BE CAREFUL !!! I had an allergic resction. Apparently snail mucin can cause that allergy to be triggered.
I absolutely love this mask I use it a couple times a week in my night routine and my skin always feels hydrated and my blemishes cleared or close to clearing up the next morning
I have eczema and my skin breaks out to most things, this mask moisturizes and leaves my skin feeling amazing without irritating it. 10/10

i REALLY wanted to love this product because of how glowy it left my skin and how hydrating it is. but it broke me out in whiteheads :( i would still recommend to people with less sensitive skim than mine!!

avis.titre: This is a holy grail for me!
avis.texte: As someone with combination skin, I loved this! The texture is amazing and it leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated. I've also noticed my skin being smoother and glowy after. This is a definite must in my skincare routine!

I have absurdly sensitive skin, where at least half of the products if not the majority I try break me out/irritate my skin. This, however is one of the few that do not bother me at all. Instead of as a mask, I've been using this in small amounts rubbed into the skin. I've found this more effective than when as a mask, in effectiveness and of course cost-wise. It is so soothing, and really does aid in breakouts as it claims. I find that it provides a bit of smoothing such that I've even been using it as a primer too. I also don't find the texture offputting at all, but rather love it. Please do not ever discontinue or change the recipe!
Did absolutely nothing to my skin. Would not recommend. Theres more options for low price point.

I absolutely love this mask. I use it about twice a week religiously and I can't recommend it enough! I keep it in a little fridge and I love to use it after I exfoliate. It leaves my skin feeling super hydrated and soft, and it's helped with my redness. Great value!

I love how easy this is to use. I like to use it during my deep hair conditioning so I can wash it off in the shower. When I have a dry skin day or a day outside or in the city I use this. It brightens my skin and I like how dewy I look after. Make sure to wash off and moisturize well and use an oil to seal it all in

Working in a high stress environment and 12 hour shifts I wanted to have a go to home spa day essentials to wash those log days away. This is a go to and I have bought many jars already. Its refreshing, cooling and no fragrant at all. Better yet it works, ive noticed my face more hydrated and more even toned when im done. Ive applied it with my hands and with one of those mask spaulas. Id recommend the spaulas. Doesnt have to be fancy. It helps to make sure you dont lose any of the product. The consistency makes it easy to drop some of the mask. Once or twice with the spatula and youll have it down. At least I did! Cant beat the price either!

I had been looking for a mask that my sensitive skin would not react poorly to and this definitely did just that. I put it in my daily routine at night every 4 days and the difference is very noticeable. My skin is more moisturized, smoother, and less red overall.
i didn't like the texture of it at all and it was very hard to wash off. i didn't notice much of a difference in my skin either.
I'm giving the Snail Rescue Mask even though I haven't yet fully used it beyond a patch test. It looks like it might be especially nice for the Summer if chilled in the fridge prior to application.

I was really worried about trying this mask as I've had some stubborn breakouts recently but I am SO pleased! I kept it in my fridge and once I put it on I let it sit for about half an hour while I did some chores, once I rinsed it off and went to bed my redness had gone down noticeably, my skin felt smooth and moisturized. Worth every penny and will be a staple in my collection.
Makes my skin so soft and helps with extraction of blackheads. First thing to have worked in a long time.

avis.titre: Slimy and didn't see much change
avis.texte: I'm not sure I used it correctly, but the texture is very slimy and challenging to rinse off which can be annoying. I just didn't see much changes, I found clay masks to be more effective.
I love how this feels going on. Lovely gel. Diminished a dry spot so it was hardly noticeable. My face felt refreshed. I will use 2-3 times a week.

avis.titre: My go to for glass skin
avis.texte: I love this mask! It can be used short term, really great for letting it sit while you shower and rinse at the end. I found it can be also used longer! I found when i let it sit for an hour or so, it really brings that moisture and glowiness back to your skin. It does when used short term as well. Its my go to product when im wanting my skin extra soft for special events.

Most of the times and i cant find products that dont burn my face with how sensitive my skin is. However this mask is great, i feel no tingling or burning. It feels hydrating and is a affordable price

I stopped using this specific face mask months ago, but I had to come here and leave a honest review for anybody who wants to use it, i'll be honest it's a great face mask very hydrating, however it's incredibly hard to wash off i'm not joking it took nearly 10 mins for me to fully wash it off when it normally takes me 5 mins with any other face mask. If you have no problem washing it off go ahead and use it but if you don't like taking forever washing off a simple face mask I cannot recommend this product whatsoever. Seems like peach slices took intensive face mask literally because it was sure a work out to remove the face mask.

avis.titre: Hydration on crack but gentle on skin
avis.texte: Texture: Jelly like and applies Transparent on the skin. Results : Glowing and Brighter skin after one use. Effect : Leaves the skin visibly smooth and hydrated. Will buy again !

Bought this mask on a whim wasn't expecting anything drastic but i will say that this mask has helped my skin look more supple and hydrated after each use! I had to remove a star because i have eczema on my chin and notice that it will burn on my red patches so for that I would strongly suggest trying this mask before purchasing to see if your skin is suitable for it.

I've tried every kind of sheet mask and mud mask, but nothing compares to this Jelly Mask. Snail Rescue is really hydrating and moisturizes deep, enhancing the look and feel of your skin from within. Say "goodbye" to jet-lagged skin!

I enjoyed this product for the cooling and glowing effect it left on my skin. I would leave it on for 15 ish minutes and my sensitive skin never had any burning, itching, or uncomfortable feeling to it. However my only complaint is that it's extremely difficult to wash off. It looks like Jello and has a very slimy consistency to it. Washing my face with water had 0 effect and I had to just wipe it off with a towel, making it not so enjoyable to use as often.
Giving this one 4 stars but only because I haven't used it yet. Looking forward to see what it does.
This makes my dry spots almost disappear. It's wonderful and very affordable!

Honestly bought this product with the intention of getting an easy, refreshing, water-based face mask that i can just keep on for a few minutes and then wash off versus using my typical clay masks which are a bother to remove. Was NOT expecting the results to be so great! Skin was sooo supple and soft as a baby's butt. I've used hydrating products, but have never felt the sensation of softness paired with hydration before, especially right after using a product. Love love love!! Religiously using it every 4 days, big difference in my dry skin. Recommend for anyone with rosacea and try skin! Superrrr calming, cooling, and anti-inflammatory. Yay!!!

avis.titre: I have dry acne prone ski
avis.texte: I have dry acne prone skin, I try to use this everytime I shower for about 5-10 minute. Its nourishing and soothing on the skin.

Love this mask! It's really easy to spread and put on, and it has a cooling sensation which is nice for those hot summer months. Whenever I have dry patched of skin (from the winter cold or harsher acne products), I use this and I can visibly see the improvement in hydration after!

I have never tried any facial products with snail mucin but I am glad I got this mask! I have some redness and noticed after the first night of using this, my skin was refreshed, soft and nourished. I have just started using this mask so I am very excited for the results!
I got this as a sample in my order and I really like this product! It's easy to apply, very moisturizing and great to use with my blemishes. I will be ordering the full size soon.

Got a free sample of this product with my purchase and it is one of the best products I have put on my face. It left my face feeling so smooth, glowing. I had a pimple coming in on my face and the bump went down significantly after I used this. I definitely recommend and will be buying the bigger size whenever I run out of the free sample!!

avis.titre: It does what it says it does!
avis.texte: I love this stuff, especially for the price! It does exactly what it says it does.. hydrates (without creating an oily feeling) exfoliates, without the harsh scrub, brightens and reduces and dark spots (this one I noticed the most!) and calms skin/reduces any redness. It leaves my skin soft, smooth, clear, and even toned and I'll definitely keep this in rotation. Oh and lots of people seem to ask but I also slept with it on. It's a little sticky so make sure not to sleep on your face lol but other than that I woke up without that sticky feeling anymore, rinsed and continued my morning routine as usual.

avis.titre: Buy it. Don't ask anymore questions. Just buy it.
avis.texte: This jelly mask has changed my skin forever! Not only does this mask feel absolutely luxurious to put on (think cold aloe on a sunburn kinda good), it has completely evened my skin tone and I haven't seen a blemish in weeks! This skincare line is popular FOR A REASON! Thank you Peach and Lily. You gave me my face back :u1F970:❤️

This is the best mask i've ever used. It made my skin feel so clean yet hydrated (I have dry skin). My skin visibly brightened and my texture went away. Would 1000000% recommend to anyone looking for a new mask.
Oh my gosh, this stuff is AMAZING. It is so light & cooling & my skin (& myself) are loving the effects!
Love that's is light and simple. Sometimes you want a slight refresher and not something that is too intense for your skin. This is the one! Love the jelly and cooling effect of it!

I'm not rlly a face mask lover, but this one is an exception! Leaves my skin feeling so smooth, soft and moisturized and looking brighter and even. Its rlly thick, more then I was expecting, so a little goes a long way. :)
Weird texture but worth it bc I can see a difference in my skin super hydrated. I use it 1-2 times a week

I don't think I will be able to live without this mask in my life. It has changed so much about my skin and shortened my skincare routine so much. I am addicted to snail mucin. I use it after extractions, tweezing, waxing and any other type of skin-trauma I inflict on myself, (after washing my face of course. Never pick at anything before washing your face) and it helps bring that irritation down immensely. I like to mix this with the Fresh Rose face mask, but this on its own is amazing too. It seems like the bad reviews are probably allergic reactions, so maybe go in store and test a snail mucin product to make sure you're not allergic, especially if you've been known to have reactions to lots of products or have certain skin conditions.
I have very dry skin and this is one of the fee products that help and dont clog my pores. I have rebought this multiple times and love it!

this is a NECESSITY for rosacea prone, sensitive, dry skin. it is so hydrating and is so soothing when I am having a rosacea flare up. it is a little hard to wash off but it helps my skin so much that I will deal with that every time

avis.titre: One of the best products on the market
avis.texte: Super hydrating and leaves your skin glowing!! It became apart of my everyday routine when the weather dropped below 30. Ive been purchasing for over a year now 😫
Sadly this mask isn't it. I woke up the next morning after using it and my skin looked so bad, not in a breakout way but the texture of my skin. I returned it as soon as possible.

avis.titre: Snail Rescue Intensive Wash-Off Jelly Mask
avis.texte: This mask is like a night cream for me, I apply it to clean skin of the face and neck and sleep like that. And in the morning I wash it off with warm water. The skin looks like it came out of a beauty salon. I am very pleased with this product.
Love this mask. My skin feels so soft and happy after using this. I have sensitive skin and this mask didn't irritate me at all

My skin felt very refreshed after I used this. Not in the way that tea tree sometimes does, but like my skin was very clean but without being squeaky. I do think it calmed some of the acne that was creeping up too.
I used twice a week for my face and my face feels soft and bright.

This mask has really helped while I've been dealing with hormonal acne. Salicylic acid treatments work great for drying out the acne, but my skin was red and irritated from being so dried out. This mask really helped reduce the redness and pain.

Last fall I started using a snail mucin serum from another K Beauty brand. It has totally transformed my skin, so I knew this mask would be great. The jelly feels cool and has no scent which I really like. I will be adding it to my weekly self care routine.

I purchased both of these products after trying a sample of them. They are both amazing products and I highly recommend trying them. I am over 50 and always like to moisturize my face daily. They don't leave any heavy residue on your skin. Just makes your skin feel very soft and hydrated! You won't be disappointed!

It makes my skin feel hydrated and I like that, I'm definitely seeing results. I will have to keep using for a little longer to see if it helps with my pigmentation or anything like that. Also quite happy with the amount you get

I recently had miconeedling performed and started tretinonin; both to improve fine lines and texture. One of the biggest side effects of tretinon that people complain about is the dry skin. I am already a fan of another brand of snail mucin but i wanted to add a face mask to my regimen to really help with adding back the moisture. This mask is the holy grail of face masks. I keep in it the refrigerator because the coolness of my skin at night is so incredibly soothing, espevially when i have a headache. It leave me skin feeling so refreshed and soft afterwards. And so far, i have not expereinced severe dryness or flakiness like most people do. I recommend this 100%.

avis.titre: If you can't decide, get it!!
avis.texte: Its not letting me add photos for some reason but after one use my skin is GLOWINGG, on top of that it faded my dark circles they look so much better! Also i paired it with their oil free moisturizer which is also so amazing.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: After I rinsed the mask off my face felt completely hydrated. I definitely recommend

avis.titre: if you're thinking of trying this mask, pls do !!
avis.texte: this mask left my skin super hydrated with a glow. the texture is also amazing. definitely worth a try !! i would purchase again

I can definitely notice how this mask sooths my acne. I will always re-order this mask and keep it handy for when those breakout times come. Sometimes I leave this on for 45 min and it is fine for my skin. I just need to make sure to keep my skin super hydrated so it doesn't dry out. But I love this mask!
First time buying this product, I've only used its once and my skin looks and feels greats. It leaves my skin soft and hydrated. I definitely will use it for results.

avis.titre: Works well on dry skin and reduces age spots!
avis.texte: I am 66 yrs old and have rosacea, dry skin with age spots, large pores and occasional acne & blackheads. I have a weird combination of issues, and no one issue is at the top of my list. With acne products my skin is too dry, when I use lines and wrinkle products I get blackheads and acne....I have been searching for products that don't cause me issues in the other areas. This mask is heavenly. It's reducing my age spots, it reduces the appearance of lines and wrinkles, it shrinks congested pores and gives me beautiful soft even smooth skin that isn't irritated or red. And no flakiness! Love this stuff. The jelly consistency is fun, and the gel is clear and doesn't look like a mask when I'm using it. It doesn't sting or tingle, it's just refreshing. I don't have any problems washing it off - but I use a thin layer of it on my face & neck. My other two P&L masks are the resurfacing one and the clay mask. I use the masks once a week on different days.
Love this! Felt tightening and my skin was clean, firm and fresh after!

I accidentally went overboard with retinol, which left my skin dry, red and stinging. I saw this in the checkout at Ulta and picked it up. It's so soothing, the stinging was immediately gone and didn't come back! My face was probably 80% back to normal after one use! I normally have very dry skin in winter, but really heavy creams break me out. This feels incredibly lightweight, but hydrates like crazy. I'll be using this all winter long, it's awesome!

The consistency here is a dense jelly, which might strike you as off-putting. You must give this product a try regardless because it is divine! your skin will feel brand new, soft, hydrated, and luxurious.

So I bought this just a day ago, as I was looking for a snail mucin product within a certain budget. Last night I decided I would let the product sit overnight (I know, it's not recommended to do that, but it worked for me). When I woke up this morning, obviously my face felt really tight, as the mask dried completely, but after I washed it off, I realized my skin just about completely cleared up (there's a bit of a breakout on my temple but it shrunk TREMENDOUSLY) and was softer and more glowy than ever. Now I should probably mention that I have EXTREMELY sensitive skin so I'm very surprised I didn't break out even more by doing this. I will say if for whatever reason you try the same thing, make sure to moisturize after washing it off. I just went in with some cocoa butter and my skin is thriving. This honestly would work pretty well as a spot treatment for stubborn breakouts, especially if you have sensitive skin like me and things like salicylic acid and benzoyl peroxide make you even more sensitive

This product is not what I would have expected. It is a jelly consistency when you first use it but somehow it becomes very calming and cooling on the skin. It is clear on the skin which is nice and it does not dry down like most facial masks do. Did it make my skin absolutely glowing after a few uses? No. However I think it is really relaxing, and I enjoy using it while winding down at night.

I got a hydrafacial and accidentally did at-home dermaplaning WAY too soon afterwards. My skin was super stingy and irritated, and I swear this product helped save my skin. I used this nightly (along with other barrier-friendly products) and my skin was feeling back to normal in a few days. I have also been using this any night I feel like my skin is a bit inflamed or irritated and it does a great job of calming it. My only complaint is that it can be pretty hard to fully get off the skin when you're done because the texture is SO thick and slippy, I do worry that I can irritate my skin with the rubbing it takes to fully remove this. Overall though, I really like this product and will keep it in rotation on days my skin really needs some TLC!
My face feels clean and refreshed, and my pores seem to get smaller every time I use it

avis.titre: So much less messy than other masks
avis.texte: This mask is so great! I love it. The texture is so unique and it feels amazing on the skin. It makes my skin feel so clean without drying it out. Its so satisfying to put on your face, it kinda feels like playing with jello. My favorite part is that the application is so much less messy compared to other masks like charcoal. Those masks are normally a pain to wash off and get everythere like in your hair. This mask is so clean and mess free. The packaging and brand name are also so adorable. 10/10 worth it! And so affordable too!
